# OmniOps
English | 中文
**OmniOps** is the company-wide AIOps platform for intelligent IT operations, focused on fast proble
m diagnosis across the entire technology stack.
It is built on the open-source DeepSeek Harness agent framework — an _everything is a plugin_ archit
ecture powered by Cordis — and extends it into an operations-diagnosis toolkit. Its cascading three-
level diagnosis scope (**TechStack → Component → Skill**) covers database deadlocks, big-key detecti
on, GPU memory/utilization, drop-card detection, and more, helping engineers locate and resolve inci
